claims.claim: Three of eight malformed public API requests returned HTTP 200.
claims.qualifier: One malformed request per API; dated interface audit, not a comprehensive benchmark.

claims.claim: 56.6 percent of 6,607 catalogued datasets had no column descriptions in the discovery metadata.
claims.qualifier: Six Socrata portals; discovery metadata may not expose every piece of portal documentation.

claims.claim: Digital 311 share was 64.7 percent in the lowest-income ZCTA quartile and 74.4 percent in the highest.
claims.qualifier: Incident ZIP is not necessarily caller residence; descriptive 2025 association.

claims.claim: Only five of the equal-weight top ten states had at least an 80 percent top-ten probability across 10,000 weight draws.
claims.qualifier: Illustrative four-variable score with deliberately broad weight uncertainty.

claims.claim: Federal Register page length and comment-window length had Spearman rho 0.109 among 1,292 valid 2025 proposed-rule records.
claims.qualifier: Page count is a rough attention proxy and excludes attachments and prior expertise.

claims.claim: Latest-value selection raised complete coverage from 72.4 to 86.6 percent, while 23.9 percent of included economies mixed indicator years.
claims.qualifier: Four selected digital-infrastructure indicators and World Bank economy definitions.
